title: ranking.requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs RankingJudgeAgent to rank candidates of a given kind. `candidate_ids` is optional: when absent, RankingJudgeAgent ranks all candidates found in `source_ref`. RankingJudgeAgent itself is out of scope for this task -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

candidate_kind.description: Kind of candidate being ranked. Only 'hypothesis' is supported for now; 'benchmark' is deferred.

candidate_ids.description: Optional subset of candidate ids to rank. Absent means: rank all candidates found in source_ref.

source_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the object containing the candidates to rank (e.g. a HypothesisBank).
